name: UltraBlur
description: Plex-identical UltraBlur ambient corner colors extracted from item artwork, with an auto-injected web client script and a REST API for native clients.
overview: Plex-style ambient gradients for Jellyfin detail pages.

versions.changelog:
- Bit-exact vs Plex Media Server 1.43.4 ground truth: 99/99 + 199/199 library art, 39/39 edge cases, 945/945 synthetic fuzz images
- Fixes vs 0.3.0: PMS median-cut (MMCQ) and libc++ sort semantics, exact-gray NaN handling, float rounding order, 1-0.8f constant
- In-process managed extraction, no native binary; decodes with the host's SkiaSharp
